description: Comptage vélo - Localisation des compteurs is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Anglet Open Data. Localisation des compteurs vélo à Anglet. Les informations proviennent de l'API Eco-visio. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are compteur, vélo. The portal shows 6 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
